tldr: 週末彙整：台股週五收在46,185點附近（漲約1.6%），迎接「超級央行週」。
Fed在9月15至16日決策、台灣央行9月17日開會，通膨黏著使升息機率仍在。
SEMI估2030年全球半導體營收達2兆美元，台積電因AI需求同時興建近20座廠。
金管會強化阻詐與安養信託，並引導保險資金挹注公共建設。
銀行看好私募市場與家族辦公室，高資產需求轉向整合式顧問服務。

items.title_zh: 台股攻堅　迎「超級央行週」
items.title_en: TAIEX rallies into a "super central-bank week"
items.summary_zh: 台股週五勁揚約1.6%、上漲逾756點，收在46,185點附近，台積電領軍，反映AI晶片需求續強。市場焦點轉向利率重頭戲：Fed於9月15至16日決策，台灣央行9月17日召開理監事會，通膨黏著使升息機率仍在。季底作帳與政策風險交錯，預料指數波動維持偏高，投資人須留意會前觀望氣氛與外資動向對權值股評價的牽動。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's benchmark TAIEX climbed about 1.6% (roughly 756 points) to close near 46,185 on Friday, with TSMC leading the advance amid resilient AI-chip demand. Attention now turns to a rate-heavy calendar: the Fed decides on Sept 15–16 and Taiwan's central bank meets Sept 17, with sticky inflation keeping a modest hike on the table. Traders expect index volatility to stay elevated as season-end positioning meets policy risk.

items.title_zh: 台積電定海神針　資金續卡位AI
items.title_en: TSMC anchors the market as AI positioning continues
items.summary_zh: 台積電股價約2,410元、上漲約1.6%，仍是盤面中流砥柱，SEMICON Taiwan後資金集中AI供應鏈。先進製程、先進封裝與矽光子（CPO）供應商續為焦點，晶圓代工、封測與光通訊股吸金。Fed決策在即，投資人對高評價標的轉趨選股，晶片族群強弱分化加劇，量能能否延續與外資態度將牽動後市多空與輪動節奏。
items.summary_en: TSMC traded around NT$2,410, up about 1.6%, remaining the market's pivot as funds concentrate in AI supply-chain names after SEMICON Taiwan. Advanced process, advanced packaging and silicon-photonics (CPO) suppliers stayed in focus, with foundry, packaging-and-test and optical-communication stocks drawing flows. Investors are turning more selective on valuations ahead of the Fed, sharpening the divergence within the chip complex.

items.title_zh: SEMI：台灣是全球AI重鎮　2030半導體營收衝2兆美元
items.title_en: SEMI: Taiwan is a global AI hub; chip revenue seen hitting US$2tn by 2030
items.summary_zh: SEMICON Taiwan上，SEMI全球總裁稱台灣是重要AI重鎮，估在AI驅動下，2030年全球半導體營收可達2兆美元。今年展會規模創高，聚焦先進封裝、小晶片（chiplet）架構、智慧晶圓廠與量子運算等前瞻主戰場，凸顯台灣在全球AI硬體建置的核心地位。相關趨勢牽動設備、材料與封測供應鏈的擴產與資本支出節奏，亦左右台股AI族群動能。
items.summary_en: At SEMICON Taiwan, SEMI's global president called Taiwan a critical AI hub and projected worldwide semiconductor revenue could reach US$2tn by 2030, powered by AI demand. The event drew record participation, spotlighting advanced packaging, chiplet architectures, smart fabs and quantum computing as next-wave battlegrounds—reinforcing Taiwan's central role in the global AI hardware buildout.

items.title_zh: 台積電同建近20廠　AI需求半年近翻倍
items.title_en: TSMC building nearly 20 fabs as AI demand nearly doubles in half a year
items.summary_zh: 台積電副共同營運長侯永清表示，這波AI需求成長速度為三十年僅見，半年內近乎翻倍，公司正同時興建近20座廠。管理層認為單純節點微縮已不足，將「系統級異質整合」定位為AI時代決勝關鍵，帶動先進封裝與CPO重金投資。擴產步調牽動設備、耗材與封測拉貨，惟須留意電力、人才與時程等瓶頸對供應鏈的影響。
items.summary_en: TSMC's deputy co-COO said AI-driven demand is growing at a pace unseen in three decades, nearly doubling within six months, prompting the company to build close to 20 fabs simultaneously. Executives argue single-node scaling is no longer enough, positioning "system-level heterogeneous integration" as the decisive edge for the AI era and driving heavy investment across advanced packaging and CPO.

items.title_zh: 金管會強化阻詐與安養信託
items.title_en: FSC steps up anti-fraud defenses and senior-care trust push
items.summary_zh: 金管會銀行局9月1日重申，民眾勿透過未經核准在台設立據點的金融機構投資，並推動「安養信託」守護樂齡族群資產；同時啟動2026金檢警聯防高峰會，結合主管機關、金檢與警政力量防詐。此舉針對線上詐騙與未經許可的跨境招攬加強防堵，在數位金融詐欺手法日益精密之際強化消費者保護，亦牽動金融機構法遵成本與信託業務布局。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's Banking Bureau reiterated on September 1 that the public should not invest through financial institutions lacking approved local operations, and promoted "senior-care trust" measures to protect retirees' assets. It also launched a 2026 anti-fraud coordination summit combining regulators, examiners and police. The moves tighten defenses against online scams and unlicensed cross-border solicitation as digital-finance fraud grows more sophisticated.

items.title_zh: 引導保險資金挹注公共建設
items.title_en: Insurance capital steered toward public infrastructure
items.summary_zh: 金管會保險局表示，正跨部會攜手擴大保險業可投資的公共建設標的範圍，引導長天期保險資金投入國內建設。透過放寬合格投資項目與相關規範，政策盼將龐大的保險資產池轉化為基礎建設的穩定資金來源，同時協助壽險業尋求穩健的長天期收益。相關鬆綁牽動保險資金運用配置與收益結構，亦與公共建設融資動能相互連動。
items.summary_en: The FSC's Insurance Bureau said regulators are working across agencies to broaden the range of public-infrastructure targets eligible for insurers' capital, channeling long-term insurance funds into domestic construction. By expanding qualifying projects and easing investment rules, the policy aims to turn Taiwan's large insurance asset pools into a stable financing source for infrastructure while supporting insurers' search for steady, long-duration yields.
items.source_name: 金融監督管理委員會保險局

items.title_zh: 銀行看好私募市場與家族辦公室
items.title_en: Bankers bullish on private markets and family offices
items.summary_zh: 台灣2026亞資高峰論壇上，銀行業者看好私募市場與家族辦公室，呼籲擴大另類資產布局、深化跨境財管服務。除傳統股債外，私募股權、私募債權、避險基金與家族辦公室服務被視為高資產客群的重要成長動能，顯示財管模式加速轉向以顧問為導向、手續費為基礎的經營。此布局牽動另類資產貨架、跨境法遵與理專專業量能，考驗銀行差異化能力。
items.summary_en: At Taiwan's 2026 Asian asset-management forum, bankers voiced optimism on private markets and family offices, urging broader allocation to alternative assets and deeper cross-border wealth services. Beyond traditional equities and bonds, private equity, private credit, hedge funds and family-office services are seen as key growth engines for high-net-worth clients—signaling a shift toward advisory-led, fee-based wealth models targeting affluent Taiwanese.

items.title_zh: 高資產需求轉向整合顧問與資產池融資
items.title_en: HNW demand shifts to integrated advisory and asset-pool financing
items.summary_zh: 銀行業者指出，高資產客戶需求已從單一商品轉向整合式財富管理，促使銀行推出以「資產池」概念的多元金融資產擔保融資，綜合評估客戶整體金融資產價值。家族辦公室服務方面，財富傳承已不只是資產移轉，更重視家族價值與治理機制的延續，深化以顧問為導向、關係經營的模式。相關趨勢牽動銀行商品貨架、授信與傳承規劃布局。
items.summary_en: Bankers say high-net-worth clients increasingly want integrated wealth management rather than single products, prompting banks to roll out multi-asset collateral financing based on an "asset pool" concept that assesses a client's overall financial holdings. In family-office services, succession is framed less as asset transfer and more as continuity of family values and governance, deepening advisory-led, relationship-based models.
